name: Clippyflow Brand Deck + Mood Board
concept: Retro-nostalgic MODERN TERMINAL that renders tiles and cards. Every slide is a polished TUI window (titlebar + traffic-light dots + mono meta) wrapping the Clippyflow spectrum brand. Boundaries enforced via flex/grid inside .cf-win-body (no free-floating absolute overflow).
design_law: Spectrum = data/meaning (cyan 186 / blue 206 / purple 257 / magenta 291 / green 142). Nitrous blue (214) = STRUCTURE ONLY (rims, focus, scrollbars, dividers, cursor, underlines). CTA fill = cyan 186 brighter, never nitrous. No raw hex in components.

typography.terminal_mono: Cascadia Code / Consolas (the modern Windows Terminal face that rendered tiles+cards)

slides.title: Color system swatch board + nitrous callout
The Nitrous Rule: structure vs data
Tiles / pills / badges / agentcards / health bar
